title: Military video of instantaneous acceleration with a weapons-grade lock, obtained and released by Corbell and Knapp

tellings.quote: dive analysis that came out, right? Because George and I obtained and released it.

plain: A military video shows an object that accelerates instantly while a weapons system has a firm, weapons-grade lock on it, and an analysis of its dive has since come out. Jeremy Corbell, a filmmaker who reports on UFOs, says he and George Knapp, a Las Vegas TV journalist, obtained the video and released it themselves. If it is what he says, the military recorded a craft moving in ways no known aircraft can.
